speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) with Auer rods.

The presence of immature cells with needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (Auer rods) on the smear confirms AML as the cause of your pancytopenia and massive leukocytosis. Given the critical nature of this condition, we must proceed immediately to initiate induction chemotherapy.
